Arasaka Acid.name: Arasaka Acid
Arasaka Acid.description:
Produces a weapon coating that improves armor ablation.

  • Effect lasts for 1 minute.

  • Only intended for use with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_weapons.Item.Ifp6KgNYeZ0wfKSN]{Arasaka Weeping Reaver Katana}

Arasaka Fire.name: Arasaka Fire
Arasaka Fire.description:
Produces a weapon coating that lights the target On Fire (Mild). The target takes 2 damage to HP at end of their turn unless they use action to extinguish flames.

  • Fire effects do not stack.

  • Effect lasts for 1 minute.

  • Only intended for use with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_weapons.Item.Ifp6KgNYeZ0wfKSN]{Arasaka Weeping Reaver Katana}

Arasaka Wound Salt.name: Arasaka Wound Salt
Arasaka Wound Salt.description:
Produces a weapon coating that adds a second critical injury applying Critical Damage.

  • Does not deal any additional Critical Damage.

  • Effect lasts for 1 minute.

  • Only intended for use with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_weapons.Item.Ifp6KgNYeZ0wfKSN]{Arasaka Weeping Reaver Katana}

Doberman 500 Marking Scent.name: Doberman 500 Marking Scent
Doberman 500 Marking Scent.description: Unique form of ammunition for the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.iSyf14qCf2US6im1]{Air Pistol}. Provides specialized scent marking on target.

Grenade (Arachnid).name: Grenade (Arachnid)
Grenade (Arachnid).description: A very sticky grenade. Creates a sticky web that entangles target. Must be destroyed or be torn by anyone in melee range making a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.dex+@skills.brawling #DV15 Brawling]]{DV15 Brawling} check.

Grenade (KTech Security).name: Grenade (KTech Security)
Grenade (KTech Security).description: Armor piercing Grenade. Deals damage to targets, but not to cover.

Grenade (Shuriken Tornado).name: Grenade (Shuriken Tornado)
Grenade (Shuriken Tornado).description:
A literal explosion of shurikens.

Roll damage individually for each target.

Net.name: Net
Net.description:
A retractable net for the net launcher that Grapples the target on hit. Targets may escape with by rolling [[/r 1d10red+@stats.dex+@skills.contortionist #DV13 Contortionist]]{DV13Contortionist} if they are trapped in the net. Targets may be freed if an ally rolls [[/r 1d10red+@stats.dex+@skills.brawling #DV13 Brawling]]{DV13 Brawling}

The Net has 15hp and is destroyed when reduced to 0.

Rocks.name: Rocks
Rocks.description:
Ammunition that can be used with the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_weapons.Item.MGWv5ebRm7FzFt9C]{Nomad Rocker}.

Ammunition is considered free and available if small rocks are able to be collected in the area the user is in.
